name: Bo kho
summary: Bò kho is beef stew, eaten in the morning on Da Nang’s Huỳnh Thúc Kháng and again at night on Phạm Hồng Thái.
origin: A Da Nang breakfast on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng.
howToEat: Eat it in the morning on the breakfast street, or at night on Phạm Hồng Thái.
where: Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, in the morning. The street is busiest from about 06:00 to 08:00, and counters serve until around noon.
Phạm Hồng Thái, after dark, from about 17:00 until after 23:00.
seoTitle: Bo kho — morning on Huynh Thuc Khang
seoDescription: Bò kho is beef stew, a morning bowl on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng in Da Nang and a night order on Phạm Hồng Thái.
